author: Yffe
content: Failing tests at thermite-spec/tests/divergence_spec.rs::divergence_corpus_binary_search_validates_clean and ::divergence_enum_ctor_in_fn_body_is_not_a_contract_position demonstrate the divergence (run with --include-ignored). Root cause: Validator::walk_block -> walk_stmt -> walk_expr applies the SpecTherm cage to ordinary fn-BODY statement expressions, but REQ-3 enumerates contract positions as Contract.req/ens, LoopNode.invs/dec, SpecFnItem.body only -- a fn body is NOT a contract position (only its nested loop inv/dec are). The body stmt 'return Some(mid);' is Expr::Call{callee:Path([Some])} and is rejected as UnknownCombinator. walk_block's own doc-comment says a fn body is not a contract position but the code does not honor it. Authority: .design/spec/spectherm-combinators.md AC-2 + REQ-3; goal.md (corpus is hand-certified external truth).
